schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS acp_scheduled_configs (
source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('web','desktop')),
schedule_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(schedule_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
engine TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(engine IN ('codex','claude')),
values_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(values_json) AND json_type(values_json)='object' AND length(CAST(values_json AS BLOB))<=262144),
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
PRIMARY KEY(source,schedule_id)) STRICT;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS acp_scheduled_configs_insert_budget BEFORE INSERT ON acp_scheduled_configs
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acp_scheduled_configs WHERE source=NEW.source AND schedule_id=NEW.schedule_id)
AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acp_scheduled_configs)>=1000 OR
 (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(length(CAST(values_json AS BLOB))),0) FROM acp_scheduled_configs)+length(CAST(NEW.values_json AS BLOB))>16777216)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ACP scheduled configuration capacity exceeded'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS acp_scheduled_configs_update_budget BEFORE UPDATE ON acp_scheduled_configs
WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(length(CAST(values_json AS BLOB))),0) FROM acp_scheduled_configs WHERE source!=OLD.source OR schedule_id!=OLD.schedule_id)+length(CAST(NEW.values_json AS BLOB))>16777216
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ACP scheduled configuration capacity exceeded'); END;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS acp_scheduled_retirements (
source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('web','desktop')),
schedule_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(schedule_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
PRIMARY KEY(source,schedule_id)) STRICT;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS acp_scheduled_retirements_budget BEFORE INSERT ON acp_scheduled_retirements
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acp_scheduled_retirements WHERE source=NEW.source AND schedule_id=NEW.schedule_id)
AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acp_scheduled_retirements)>=1000
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'ACP scheduled retirement capacity exceeded'); END;

update: UPDATE acp_scheduled_configs SET engine=?,values_json=?,revision=revision+1 WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND revision=? RETURNING source, schedule_id, engine, values_json, revision
delete: DELETE FROM acp_scheduled_configs WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND revision=?
retire: INSERT INTO acp_scheduled_retirements SELECT source,schedule_id,revision FROM acp_scheduled_configs WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? ON CONFLICT(source,schedule_id) DO UPDATE SET revision=excluded.revision
retirements: SELECT schedule_id,revision FROM acp_scheduled_retirements WHERE source=? ORDER BY schedule_id
finalize: DELETE FROM acp_scheduled_configs WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND revision=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acp_scheduled_retirements WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND revision=?)
forgetRetirement: DELETE FROM acp_scheduled_retirements WHERE source=? AND schedule_id=? AND revision=?
